result.summary: The main defect is the bottom navigation bar, which ignores the device's bottom safe area. Its icons are cut off by the screen edge, and the system gesture handle is drawn over them. The rest of the page (header, search, chips, promo banner, carousels, list cards) renders correctly, apart from the intentional carousel and list clipping that was excluded.

issues.description: The bottom navigation bar is pushed below the visible area. Its icons (Home, Search, Orders, Profile) are cut off at the bottom of the screen, with only their top halves visible, and any text labels are hidden entirely.
issues.suggestion: Add the device's bottom safe-area inset (e.g., env(safe-area-inset-bottom) or WindowInsets) as padding under the navigation bar so all icons and labels sit fully above the screen edge.

issues.description: The system home-indicator / gesture bar overlaps the Search and Orders icons in the bottom navigation. These icons are partly hidden, and taps near them may trigger the system gesture instead of the tab.
issues.suggestion: Keep interactive navigation content out of the system gesture zone by respecting bottom insets, or increase the nav bar height so the icons sit above the gesture handle.
